data.name: They See Me Rollin'
data.detailed_description:
THEY SEE ME ROLLIN’ is a chaotic arcade racing game where giant rocks blast through insane tracks filled with boosts, hazards, jump pads, mines, collapsing traffic, and total multiplayer mayhem.

Race online with friends or battle offline against aggressive AI racers across procedural tracks built for speed, collisions, and unpredictable moments. Boost through hazards, launch off massive jumps, slam opponents into walls, and fight your way to the finish line before time runs out.

Every race is a blast!

FEATURES

• Chaotic Arcade Racing
Roll, boost, bounce, and smash through high-speed obstacle-filled tracks designed for constant action.

• Online Multiplayer
Jump into quick online matches and race against players in frantic physics-based competition.

• Offline Play
Practice, experiment, or battle AI racers offline with instant restarts and fast arcade pacing.

• Procedural Tracks
Tracks are generated dynamically, creating fresh race layouts, hazards, turns, and obstacle combinations every run.

• Customize Your Rock
Build your own ridiculous racing rock with different shapes, materials, decals, colors, and cosmetic combinations.

• Physics-Driven Gameplay
Collisions, boosts, jump pads, mines, and environmental hazards create unpredictable races where anything can happen.

• Fast Match Flow
Short races, rapid rematches, and seamless restarts keep the action moving without long downtime.

Whether you're fighting for first place, bouncing your friends off the track, or barely surviving a chain reaction of mines and jump pads, THEY SEE ME ROLLIN’ is built for quick, chaotic fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or equivalent Vulkan-capable GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
